test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sentences contains an adverbial error?

options.text: He sang beautifully at the talent show
The teacher spoke clear and concise
They danced gracefully across the stage.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. The teacher spoke clear and concise .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence contains an adverbial error as "clear" should be "clearly" to correctly modify the verb "spoke".
 
• Adverbs are used to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs and often end in "-ly".
 
• The correct structure should be: "The teacher spoke clearly and concisely."

Correct sentence: *The teacher spoke clearly and concisely*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverb Usage:**

 
 
• **Adverbs of Manner:** Describe how something is done. Example: He ran quickly.
 
• **Adverbs of Time:** Indicate when something happens. Example: She will come tomorrow.
 
• **Adverbs of Place:** Indicate where something happens. Example: They looked everywhere.
